0.original: Saikoro's entire countenance reeks of desperation.

26.original: Defeat the shiranui and obtain the wakizashi.

48.original: Thank the kami for finally sending someone who I can turn to for help! Please, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, I need you to do me a favor, but it is something that must stay between us.

49.original: The other day, I was out for a stroll in the <hex:021A020203>Kobayashi Maru<hex:021A020103> to the northeast of here when I came across a wakizashi. It was beautiful. When I went to grab it, however, this ghastly tentacled creature appeared from nowhere and chased me away!

50.original: I want that wakizashi so badly, but if I appeal to anyone here for assistance, they will laugh in my face again and call me a coward. Might you go there and obtain it for me?

51.original: Please, bring me the wakizashi I spotted in the <hex:021A020203>Kobayashi Maru<hex:021A020103>. It is to the northeast of here. Once I get it, maybe then everyone will stop teasing me!

52.original: You thoroughly search the area but are unable to find the wakizashi.

53.original: It was not there? Bah! That vile creature must have wrapped its slimy arms around it and taken it back to its home, then!

54.original: Please, you must track it down and seize my wakizashi from it. It is likely in Onokoro with all the other...<shudder>...sh-shiranui.

55.original: Those gruesome beasts all look very similar so you may have to confront a few of them before you find the one with my wakizashi.

56.original: Were you able to find my wakizashi?

57.original: Yes─this is it! Haha! At long last I have obtained my first treasure! Now I am a true Kojin of the Blue!

58.original: While I might not be the bravest, I do have the rare gift of seeing through people. Right away, I knew you were a kind and trustworthy individual.

59.original: This ability has served me well in trading and has allowed me to establish many good relationships with the people around me─such as yourself! May our friendship last a lifetime!
